description: This file defines platform-independent interfaces, data structures, function pointer types, constants, and macros for a TLS Crypto Provider Object used in Transport Layer Security implementations. It specifies the API for cryptographic operations, key management, and other TLS-related functionalities.

classes.name: TLS_CRYPTO_PROVIDER_OBJECT
classes.description: Struct representing the platform-independent TLS cryptographic provider object, encapsulating function pointers and handles for TLS cryptography operations.

methods.name: GetCipherInfo
methods.description: Retrieves information about the cipher suite being used.

methods.name: DecapRSAPublicKey
methods.description: Decapsulates an RSA public key given its keying material.

methods.name: GenerateRSAKeys
methods.description: Generates RSA public and private keys.

methods.name: GetRandomBytes
methods.description: Generates random bytes for cryptographic use.

methods.name: Compute_PRF30
methods.description: Computes the TLS PRF using hash-30 (SSL 3.0) methodology.

methods.name: Encrypt_RSA
methods.description: Encrypts data using RSA public key.

methods.name: Decrypt_RSA
methods.description: Decrypts data using RSA private key.

methods.name: Sign
methods.description: Creates a digital signature using specified key and algorithm.

methods.name: Hash
methods.description: Computes hash of data with specified algorithm.

methods.name: Hmac
methods.description: Computes HMAC with specified hash algorithm.

methods.name: Encrypt
methods.description: Encrypts data with specified cipher and key.

methods.name: Decrypt
methods.description: Decrypts data with specified cipher and key.
